chatgpt.notes: Consumed at runtime by lib/chatgpt-adapter.js (content script dynamic-imports that module). DOM result-row selectors for fallback not yet live-confirmed; endpoint-first per S1.

selectors.signIn: a[href*="/signin"], button[aria-label*="Sign in" i], a[aria-label*="Sign in" i]

perplexity.notes: Endpoint-first per S3: POST list_ask_threads with search_term + session cookies. Capability title-match until proven full-text. Spaces: rely on C (search_term may return Space-tagged threads). Per-Space thread routes gated off until live-proven (spaceThreadsCandidates empty; SPACE_THREAD_ENUMERATION_ENABLED=false). Former ladder B page-anchor scrape is not Spaces recovery and is omitted.

selectors.loginShell: a[href*="/login"], button[aria-label*="Continue with Google" i], a[aria-label*="Continue with Google" i], button[aria-label*="Continue with email" i]

claude.notes: Endpoint-first per S2: GET organizations → paginated chat_conversations (client title-match after full-page normalize) → Projects directory + per-project conversations (breadth-first page-1 then deepen, budget-capped). Deep link https://claude.ai/chat/{uuid}. Prefill not supported. Capability title-match. Soft caps: root ~100 / per-project ~60 still authorize empty by design (BL-024). Failure/budget/failed-project truncation → unavailable/timeout not empty (BL-022). DOM Recents search fallback deferred (BL-023). include_harmony_projects omitted until live-proven.

selectors.signIn: a[href*="accounts.google.com"], button[aria-label*="Sign in" i], a[aria-label*="Sign in" i]
selectors.accountChip: img[alt*="Google Account" i], button[aria-label*="Google Account" i], a[aria-label*="Google Account" i]

gemini.notes: DOM-first per S4: no stable first-party history search endpoint at desk. Title-match on history rail links (/app/{id}). Prefill none — cascade deep link → https://gemini.google.com/app. Auth (S5): login_required only when Sign in CTAs AND 'Sign in to save activity' are both visible without owner signals; one-signal alone → unavailable. Soft reach ceiling: HISTORY_SCROLL_MAX_ROUNDS (~8) / HISTORY_ITEM_SOFT_CAP (~120) still authorize empty by design when the history rail (or empty-history state) is proven and the scanned window has no title match. Incomplete: budget exhausted mid-scan → timeout (history_budget_exhausted); rail never proven → unavailable (history_rail_missing) — never empty. Account chip alone does not prove the rail. Selectors stub-level pending live polish (BL-025). Gems/folders: any visible /app/ history links are collected; no invented Projects clone.
